decisions.decision: CVE-2026-8643 Directory Traversal in pip; affects all versions, no published fix (patch unreleased in pip master). pip is the installer captured by uv pip freeze, not a shipped runtime dependency; exploit needs a malicious wheel installed with elevated privileges, outside threat model. Coverage retained via pip-audit, semgrep, gitleaks, SBOM, Scorecard.
